content_sections.heading: WCD&SC Jagtial Anganwadi Teacher Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should note that only applications submitted online through the official WCD&SC portal will be accepted; applications sent by post, email, or submitted directly at DWO/CDPO/Anganwadi offices will not be considered for selection.

rows.event: Certificate verification at ICDS Project office

content_sections.heading: WCD&SC Jagtial Anganwadi Teacher Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 64 Anganwadi Teacher posts are vacant across the four ICDS Projects of Jagtial district. The project-wise break-up is as follows: Each of the 64 posts is tied to a specific Anganwadi Center (AWC) and carries its own local reservation category (OC, BC-A/B/C/D/E, SC, ST, EWS, or VH-earmarked), based on the Mandal, Gram Panchayat/Ward and AWC where the vacancy exists. Three posts - at Venkatapur (Dharmapuri project), Medipally (Jagtial project) and Peddapur (Metpalli project) - are specifically earmarked for candidates with visual handicap (VH) under the disability reservation. The complete AWC-wise list with reservation category and dates is available in the official notification on the WCD&SC Jagtial portal.

content_sections.heading: WCD&SC Jagtial Anganwadi Teacher Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed their Intermediate (12th class) or an equivalent qualification. This is a mandatory requirement for all applicants. Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly. Only women candidates are eligible to apply. Applicants must be local residents of the specific area served by the vacant Anganwadi Center - urban applicants must reside in the concerned ward, and rural applicants must reside in the concerned Gram Panchayat where the vacancy is located. Posts allotted to SC or ST habitations under the SC/ST sub-plan are open only to SC or ST candidates residing in that specific habitation or allotted locality, as applicable. The notification does not specify further reservation details beyond what is listed against each AWC in the vacancy annexure.

content_sections.heading: WCD&SC Jagtial Anganwadi Teacher Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is made purely on a merit-cum-points basis, out of a maximum of 100 marks, as follows: Required documents for verification include the SSC/date-of-birth and Intermediate qualification certificates, a residence certificate issued by the Tahsildar within the last one year, the Intermediate/higher qualification marks memo, and, where applicable, caste certificate and special-category certificates (disability, widow, or orphan certificate under the JJ Act, 2015).

faq.question: Q1. What is WCD&SC Jagtial Anganwadi Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the WCD&SC Department, Jagtial District, Telangana, to fill 64 Anganwadi Teacher posts across the Dharmapuri, Jagtial, Mallial and Metpalli ICDS Projects, notified vide No. B1/508/2026 dated 05-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 64 vacancies in total: 16 in Dharmapuri, 22 in Jagtial, 12 in Mallial, and 14 in Metpalli project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 21-08-2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Intermediate (12th class) or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01-07-2026.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the official portal, wdcw.tg.nic.in, between 07-08-2026 and 21-08-2026.
